text:
Alex (eng-platform): Heads-up — saw a small spike of 503s on /rerank yesterday late-afternoon. Suspect backpressure when candidate batch > 120 + long KV cache misses. Opening thread to propose changes: shrink scoring payload, route to quant model on pressure, and add console + Slack signals for fallback. Anyone seen this pattern before?

Sara (eng-runtime): saw similar on mon. tail-lat histogram linked: https://intra/graphs/rerank/tail-lat — big jump around 17:12. I think batching + one noisy tenant caused queue blowup.

Dan (eng-sre): we had an alert but it fired too late. Current alert is >95th latency for 5m. We should add a queue-length gauge and an early-backpressure alert (e.g., queue_len > 80 for 30s).

Mike (product): product ask: if we route to a lower-fidelity model, frontend needs a degradation flag so UX can show "best-effort" text. Also need a telemetry count for degraded responses.

Tereza (eng-ml): score-normalization idea: instead of sending full float vector we can shrink to 1 score per candidate and a compact provenance bitmask. But downstream thresholds break. Proposal: add shrink_method param that indicates how the score was produced ("raw","norm_by_logk","per_candidate_shrink").

Alex (eng-platform): sketch of runtime config I had in mind:
```
routing:
  rerank:
    queue_threshold: 120        # queue length to start routing fallback
    fallback_model: "rerank-2.1-quant"
    shrink_method: "per_candidate"
    shrink_factor: 0.75        # multiply scores when shrinking so max stays <1
```

Sara (eng-runtime): +1 for queue_threshold. For implementation: prefer probe-based routing trigger (sample every N requests check queue_len) rather than per-request check to avoid contention.

Dan (eng-sre): also suggest soft quotas per-tenant: when usage > commit and queue_len high, start shedding non-critical routes (rerank-debug, heavy telemetry). Hard rejects only if queue_len > 300.

Tereza (eng-ml): about score formats — we should version the envelope so consumers can safely parse. Example envelope v2: { "score": 0.82, "meta": ["shrink:per_candidate","seed:xyz"] }. That keeps parsing stable.

Mike (product): Console UX: show a per-route "fallback active" badge and a timeseries for fallback_count + backpressure_rate. Also a tenant table with current route state (normal / degraded / blocked).

Sara (eng-runtime): telemetry metric names proposal: `rerank.queue_len`, `rerank.backoff_rate`, `rerank.fallback_count`, `rerank.score_shrink_applied` (tagged by tenant/model). Make sure fallback_count increments only when a full response is returned (not for probes).

Alex (eng-platform): rollout plan: canary 1% (30m), assess metrics (latency, fallback_count, eval score), then 10% (2h), 50% (1d), full. We'll run evaluation set on each stage to detect quality regressions.

Tereza (eng-ml): eval hooks: compare top-k stability and MRR on saved prompt set. If drop > 2% stop rollout. Also record per-tenant drift so we can rollback targeted tenants.

Dan (eng-sre): alerts to add: `rerank.queue_len > 80 for 30s` (warning), `rerank.fallback_count rate > 5% over 5m` (critical), and `rerank.score_parse_errors > 0` (critical).

ci-bot: deploy scheduled: config branch `rerank/backpressure-2026` -> staging at 2501238900.

Alex (eng-platform): action items:
- Alex: prototype probe-based routing + config flags (ETA 2d)
- Sara: add queue_len gauge + metrics tagging in runtime (ETA 3d)
- Tereza: build eval job and early-stop hook (ETA 4d)
- Dan: add and tune alerts, add incident runbook snippet (ETA 2d)
- Mike: mockup console badge + tenant table (ETA 5d)

Sara (eng-runtime): small note — ensure we emit `score_envelope_version` on every response; saves a lot of parsing headaches.

Mike (product): can we surface a human-readable reason in the response header when fallback used? e.g., `X-Rerank-Mode: fallback-queue-pressure`. That helps support.

Alex (eng-platform): yep, add `X-Rerank-Mode` and `X-Rerank-Score-Method`.

Tereza (eng-ml): one last caution: shrinking can bias some rare classes. we'll include a per-candidate confidence flag so downstream can re-rank if needed.

Dan (eng-sre): acked. If no objections I'll merge the config RFC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Mike (product): +1

Sara (eng-runtime): +1

Alex (eng-platform): thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the coordination log.
